Hi Samir —

Thanks — received the MAP. Quick read-through and a couple of immediate thoughts on contingency triggers to avoid close-date slippage:

1) Dual acceptance gates: functional acceptance (integration smoke tests + perf under 95th pct latency) and compliance acceptance (SOC2 artifact checklist). Both must clear for go-live.
2) Procurement contingency: if PO lags >14 days, we can start a 2-week pilot on Redwood Hosted with a credit backstop to keep the evaluation on-track.
3) Canary rollout window: add a 3-day soft-go with rollback criteria (error rate >2% or sustained latency +30% vs baseline).
4) Time-buffer: add a 10-business-day buffer between evaluation completion and contract signature for unplanned procurement friction.

Proposed near-term actions:
- Grace: can you confirm the SOC2 artifact set we can provide for Pulse?
- Aditya: please draft a short contingency clause we can share with their procurement (pilot + credit backstop).

If those look reasonable, I’ll produce an updated MAP (v3a) with the contingency lanes and tentative dates.

—Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Filing a quick risk log (see attachment) and a suggested re-baselined timeline below. I tried to be conservative on procurement lead times based on recent deals (esp. larger PO lanes).

Top risks:
- Procurement delay (likelihood: medium, impact: high) — mitigation: pilot + credit backstop or provisional MSA signature.
- Security evidence turnaround (likelihood: low, impact: medium) — mitigation: provide redacted SOC2 artifacts immediately upon NDA.
- Integration test flakiness (likelihood: medium, impact: medium) — mitigation: assign CS sandbox engineer and schedule a 3-day joint smoke window.

Suggested timeline (re-baselined):
- 8/10: NDA executed (if possible)
- 8/12–8/25: Access provisioned; integration + perf evaluation window (2 weeks)
- 8/26–9/02: Acceptance run and canary soft-go (1 week)
- 9/03–9/13: Procurement & signature window (10 business days buffer applied)
- 9/14: Target go-live (if acceptance criteria met)
